name: The New Blacks Prugna
blurb: Adding personality and individuality by playing with lights and shadows, The New Blacks Prugna is elegantly simple yet extremely striking. Dark and bold, this is a surface that can be combined with matching intensive tones or contrasted with bold, light colourways for a look that is truly your own.
